title: Tickers REST route missing chain filter
what_breaks: Store.getLatestTickers() accepts a chain filter, but GET /api/tickers doesn't pass one. Dashboard can't filter by chain without fetching all and filtering client-side.
fix: Add chain param to GET /api/tickers and pass to store.getLatestTickers().

title: Signals REST route missing symbol filter
what_breaks: Store.getSignals() accepts symbol filter, but GET /api/signals doesn't expose it. Dashboard can't request signals for a specific symbol via REST.
fix: Add symbol param to GET /api/signals route.

title: No cursor-based pagination on list endpoints
what_breaks: All list routes use limit-only pagination. On growing data, offset drift causes missed/duplicate rows. Dashboard polling eventually loses data.
fix: Add optional `?cursor=<ts_utc>` to list endpoints returning rows after that timestamp.

title: Klines REST missing indicators-inline option
what_breaks: Charts need OHLCV + RSI/MACD/BB in one response. GET /api/klines returns raw klines only. Dashboard building candlestick charts with indicator overlays must make N+1 API calls.
fix: Add `?indicators=rsi,macd,bb` flag to GET /api/klines/:symbol returning computed indicators alongside klines.

title: No tokens REST endpoint
what_breaks: Token list exists in tokens.ts but has no REST endpoint. Dashboard must hardcode token list or use CLI subprocess.
fix: Add GET /api/tokens returning symbol, name, chain, pair for all tracked tokens.

title: No regime REST endpoint
what_breaks: Market regime detection is CLI-only. Dashboard can't display Trending/Ranging/Volatile labels without duplicating logic.
fix: Add GET /api/regime/:symbol running detectRegime() on latest klines.

title: No ticker_history / signal_history REST endpoints
what_breaks: Store has time-series history tables but no REST routes. Dashboard time-series charts require raw SQLite access.
fix: Add GET /api/ticker-history/:symbol and GET /api/signal-history/:symbol with from/limit params.

title: WS missing event IDs for reconnection replay
what_breaks: WS broadcasts have no monotonic event_id. On reconnect, dashboard cannot request missed messages. Every disconnect loses state.
fix: Add incrementing event_id to each broadcast. Client sends last_event_id on reconnect; server replays from bounded buffer.

title: No per-consumer inbound rate limiting
what_breaks: RateLimiter protects outbound Binance calls only. REST handler has no inbound limiting. A frontend polling every 100ms degrades the daemon for all consumers.
fix: Wrap REST handler with per-IP token-bucket. Default: 10 req/s per IP, burst 20.

title: No OpenAPI specification
what_breaks: API contract exists only in TypeScript source. Frontend devs must read rest.ts to understand request/response shapes. No Swagger UI, no codegen, no discoverable contract.
fix: Generate OpenAPI 3.0 spec. Options: typedoc-openapi, hand-write openapi.yaml, or zod-to-openapi.

title: No Dockerfile for container deployment
what_breaks: Cannot deploy as container. Every deployment requires Node.js + npm + Python + ML deps manually installed.
fix: Create Dockerfile (Node 26 + Python + ML deps) and docker-compose.yml.

title: No API version prefix
what_breaks: Routes are at /api/tickers not /api/v1/tickers. Adding /api/v2/ while maintaining backward compat is impossible.
fix: Add /api/v1/ route prefix alongside bare /api/. Document /api/v1/ as stable.

title: No config-write API for dashboard settings
what_breaks: Token watchlist, alert thresholds, webhook config are file-based (radar.config.json). Dashboard cannot update these without filesystem access. Blocks settings UI.
fix: Add POST /api/config (token-gated) accepting config patches, writing to radar.config.json, triggering config reload.

title: Daemon should serve dashboard static assets
what_breaks: Daemon serves API only. Dashboard must be separate process with separate deployment, CORS, and WS concerns. Single-process pattern (Grafana, Prometheus) is simpler for dev-tool dashboards.
fix: Add --frontend-dir flag. When set, daemon serves static files at / with API at /api/. Single deployable: crypto-radar daemon --frontend-dir ./frontend/dist.
